turns.text: Whilst I'm here, let me give you another tip.
turns.zh: 趁我在这儿，再给你一个提示。

turns.text: In Part 1, you'll also get 'How often do you 'do that' questions, right?
turns.zh: 在Part 1里，你还会遇到「你多久……一次」这种问题，对吧？

turns.text: And most people say: And most people say: "Well, I usually do it", "I often do it", "I never do it".
turns.zh: 大多数人会说：「嗯，我通常做」，「我经常做」，「我从不做」。

turns.text: But you could improve your answer by using adverbial phrases, like: "from time to time", "now and again", "now and then", "once in a blue moon", Just note, these adverbial phrases will come at the beginning of the phrase or at the end of the phrase, not usually between the subject and the verb.
turns.zh: 但你可以用副词短语来改进你的回答，比如：「时不时」，「偶尔」，「间或」，「难得一次」。注意，这些副词短语会放在句首或句尾，通常不会放在主语和动词之间。

turns.text: 'I do it from time to time,' or 'From time to time I do it.' So use these adverbial phrases to improve your answers.
turns.zh: 「我时不时做」，或者「时不时我做」。所以用这些副词短语来改进你的回答。
